title: Doctoral student in Computer Science with a focus on Secure Coordination and Interaction in Distributed AI
about: Fixed-term doctoral studentship at Örebro University on secure coordination and interaction in distributed AI, linked to the RESIST cyber-resilient AI centre. Topics include interaction protocols between agents, robots and people, and safeguarding agent interactions against manipulation and unsafe behaviour.

upskill.name: AI Agent & Tool-Use Security
why: 'safeguarding agent interactions against manipulation and unsafe behaviour' (role focus; no formal requirements in the record) → 'Design agent architectures that remain controlled, observable, and recoverable even when model behavior is probabilistic, unexpected, or influenced by malicious inputs.'

'interaction protocols between agents, robots and people' → 'Address excessive agency, insecure tool execution, permission escalation, unintended actions, unsafe chaining of capabilities, and exploitation of agent decision-making.'
